defs.def: the process or method of building or making sth, especially roads, buildings, bridges, etc. 建筑；建造；施工

ex.s: Mike Sullivan, a former construction worker, took up woodworking after he and his wife, Judy, retired.
ex.t: 迈克·沙利文，一名前建筑工人，在和妻子朱迪退休后开始做木工。

ex.s: Construction is more important than design.
Located __________ the Belt meets the Road, Jiangsu will contribute more to the Belt and Road construction.
ex.t: 江苏地处“一带一路”交汇点，将为“一带一路”建设作出更大贡献。

ex.s: And look up - construction workers are building impressive, original buildings in every neighbourhood.
ex.t: 抬头看——建筑工人们正在每个街区建造令人印象深刻的原创建筑。

ex.s: Today, foxes can be seen all over London - one even being found living on the 72nd floor of the Shard building when it was under construction!
ex.t: 如今，伦敦到处都能看到狐狸——有一只甚至被发现住在碎片大厦的72层，当时大楼还在建设中！

ex.s: Ted 35 Construction worker (1 picture) Each day at the construction site is more or less the same - tiring!
ex.t: 泰德，35岁，建筑工人：建筑工地的每一天都差不多——累！

ex.s: Using thousands and thousands of sandbags, we built a twenty- kilometre wall along the lake to protect it from construction waste.
ex.t: 我们用成千上万个沙袋，沿着湖边建起了一道二十公里长的墙，以保护湖泊免受建筑垃圾的污染。

ex.s: As their population expanded, yet more land was needed for agriculture and more trees for construction.
ex.t: 随着人口的增长，需要更多的土地用于农业，更多的木材用于建筑。

defs.def: the way that sth has been built or made 建造（或构造）的方式
a thing that has been built or made 建造物；构筑物；制成物
the way in which words are used together and arranged to form a sentence, phrase, etc. （句子、短语等的）结构

ex.s: Xiao long bao (soup dumplings), those amazing constructions of delicate dumpling wrappers, encasing hot, ____36____ (taste) soup and sweet, fresh meat, are far and away my favorite Chinese street food.
ex.t: 小笼包（汤包），那些由精致面皮包裹着的奇妙杰作，里面包着滚烫____36____（taste）的汤汁和香甜鲜嫩的肉馅，绝对是我最喜欢的中国街头小吃。

defs.def: the creating of sth from ideas, opinions and knowledge （理念、观点和知识的）创造，创立，建立
the way in which words, actions, statements, etc. are understood by sb （对词语、行为、陈述等的）解释，说明，理解
